highlights_headline: The next SkiaSharp release drops packaged native assets for 32-bit Linux x86.

breaking.title: Move Linux x86 deployments to a supported architecture
breaking.body: Linux x86 native assets are no longer included in NuGet packages. Move 32-bit Linux x86 deployments to a supported architecture before upgrading; applications that still require those assets must remain on an earlier release that supplies them.
